content.value:
Write down the pseudocode and detailed algorithm to input electricity unit charges and 12   
calculate total electricity bill according to given conditions:   
For first 50 units, Tk 2.00/unit   
For next 100 units, Tk 2.50/unit   
For next 100 units, Tk 3.00/unit   
For unit above 250 units, Tk 4.00/unit   
An additional surcharge of 20% is added to the bill.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
